capabilities: Insert a dated level-2 heading for the current day via a command
Prefix bullet entries with the current time while typing
Jump to and focus below the newest dated heading
Show a status bar indicator when the note contains a dated heading
Reuse Daily Note date format settings, falling back to ISO YYYY-MM-DD
disambiguation: Not a time-tracking or hours-reporting tool; it only inserts timestamps into note text and navigates dated headings.
extras: Manual installation only: users must clone the repository and copy main.js and manifest.json into the plugins folder; no community plugin store install is described.
motivation: The author built it to remove "the busywork of stamping times and jumping between sections so you can stay focused on the work itself."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically timestamp list entries under dated headings or jump back to the newest log section while keeping a lab-style work log.
summary: Lab-notebook logging plugin that inserts time-stamped bullet entries under dated headings in a running project log note.
